criteria.label: Thought flow
criteria.question: Can I follow the explanation naturally?

criteria.label: Meaning blocks
criteria.question: Do blocks correspond to coherent ideas rather than sentence fragments?

criteria.label: Traversal
criteria.question: Is it clear why the explanation moves from one block to the next?

criteria.label: Compression
criteria.question: Was language removed without removing useful explanatory work?

criteria.label: Reconstruction burden
criteria.question: Am I doing more mental work than in E0?

criteria.label: Structure utility
criteria.question: Does E2 expose the system of the explanation without flattening it?

criteria.label: Paragraph independence
criteria.question: Did the compiler discover blocks rather than copy paragraph boundaries?

criteria.label: Semantic and epistemic fidelity
criteria.question: Are meaning, qualification, scope, certainty, and causality preserved?

criteria.label: Recoverability
criteria.question: Can every block and transition be traced back?

criteria.label: Resolution preference
criteria.question: Which view is useful for first learning versus later review, if any?
